Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week. We’d love to schedule an executive sponsor demo to walk Priya and the leadership team through the high‑level architecture, reliability guarantees, and a short ROI run‑through tailored to the banking use cases you mentioned.

High level ask: can we get a 45‑minute slot where your CIO (Priya Shah) and one other executive sponsor (VP of Engineering or Head of Platforms) can join? On our side Rishi (Account Exec) and Jonas (Solutions Lead) will attend, and I’ll run the sponsor portion of the demo.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thurs 26 Mar, 10:00–10:45am
- Fri 27 Mar, 9:00–9:45am
- Mon 30 Mar, 11:00–11:45am

Attached is a short agenda for the sponsor demo and a draft mutual action plan. If none of these work, happy to propose a couple more windows. Once we confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and brief pre-read.

Thanks — appreciate the coordination.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the note and the materials. Priya is interested but her calendar is a little tight next week due to board travel. Quick answers:
- Priya Shah (CIO) would be the right sponsor to join.
- I should also be on the call (Head of Platforms) along with our SVP of Ops if available.

From the slots you proposed, Friday 27 Mar 9:00am PST looks the most promising for me today, but I need to confirm with Priya. Can you hold that slot tentatively? If she can’t do it, we’ll need to move to the following week.

One quick ask: can Redwood have someone from engineering on the call who can speak to uptime/SLA commitments and VPC/private deployment options? Rishi mentioned Jonas but wanted to confirm.

I’ll get back by end of day tomorrow with Priya’s confirmation.
